recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the applied FHIR-55410 clarification across the current build authoritative definition and mapping-exception source without expanding the decision to unrelated W3C provenance text.
issue_request: FHIR-55410 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Provenance. It requested clarification of the wording that said an activity MAY include consuming, processing, or transforming entities because Provenance does not track read/query or validation-only actions; consumed or processed entities matter when they are involved in producing a target, and MAY was not intended as conformance language.
initial_application: Jira linked HL7/fhir#4066. Git commit 018de58a90 changed source/provenance/provenance-introduction.xml so the W3C model Activity bullet says the activity acts upon output (.target) resources, but it did not update the active Provenance.activity ElementDefinition or the Event mapping exception source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists provenance=Provenance, making source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml current build input. Security WG minutes page 441519513 records FHIR-55410 in the 2026-03-30 block vote. FHIR-55409 is a same-PR neighboring Provenance W3C model wording issue and was audited separately.
reconciliation: Updated source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml and source/provenance/provenance-event-mapping-exceptions.xml to say the activity acts upon output (.target) resources, matching the already-applied Provenance introduction wording.
source_changes: source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml: changed Provenance.activity definition from broad consuming/processing wording to output (.target) resources wording.
source/provenance/provenance-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: aligned the Event.code/Provenance.activity mapping exception resource value with the updated definition.
